svg.text: A type error is a return value landing outside its fiber
For (a=12, b=8), the target type is the fiber Gcd(12, 8) = {4}; returning g = 2 or g = 8 misses the fiber
1. Fiber Space Over b = 8 (Focus at Input a = 12)
Well-typed output must land in the purple ring at a = 12
lands in Gcd(8,8), wrong fiber for a=12!
2. Why Wrong Candidates Fail the Predicate
Required type predicate: Div(g) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8) = {1, 2, 4}
TYPE ERROR: Candidate g = 12 (returns input a)
Inhabits Gcd(12, 0) or Gcd(12, 12), NOT Gcd(12, 8)
TYPE ERROR: Candidate g = 8 (returns input b)
Inhabits Gcd(8, 8) and Gcd(16, 8), NOT Gcd(12, 8)
TYPE ERROR: Candidate g = 2 (non-maximal common divisor)
Inhabits Gcd(2, 8) and Gcd(6, 8), NOT Gcd(12, 8)
